subject: 🎓 New online class — $class_name ($module_code)
body:
Dear $participant_name,

An online class has been set up for $module_name ($module_code). Details are below — please save them, you will need the link and access code to join.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
HOW TO JOIN
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Join link:        $join_url
Meeting ID:       $meeting_id
Access code:      $passcode
Platform:         $platform

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
CLASS DETAILS
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Class:            $class_name
Module:           $module_name ($module_code)
Lecturer:         $host_name
First session:    $session_date at $start_time
Duration:         $duration_minutes minutes

$session_notes

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

BEFORE YOU JOIN

  • Test your camera, microphone and connection in advance.
  • Join 2-3 minutes early.
  • Keep your microphone muted until you speak.

Do not share the link or access code outside your class.

Kind regards,
$sender_name
